questions.question: 33562. All are functions of epithelial tissue except:
questions.explain:
✅ Why D is correct:
● Epithelial tissue performs absorption, secretion, and some contractility in specialized cells, but globulin synthesis is a function of plasma cells (immune cells), not epithelial tissue.

questions.question: 33561. Compared to hepatic bile, gall bladder bile Glucose contains a reduced concentration of which of the following?
questions.explain:
✅ Why A is correct:
● Gall bladder bile is concentrated by absorption of water and electrolytes; therefore, water concentration is reduced compared to hepatic bile.

questions.question: 33560. Non cardiac causes of atrial fibrillation is:
questions.explain:
✅ Why A is correct:
● Pneumonia and other lung diseases can cause atrial fibrillation due to hypoxia and systemic stress.
● Chronic liver disease, kidney disease, and stroke are less commonly direct causes.

questions.question: 33559. Following are the causes of vertigo except:
questions.explain:
✅ Why D is correct:
● Bell’s palsy is a facial nerve palsy causing facial weakness, not vertigo.
● Benign positional vertigo, acoustic neuroma, vestibular neuritis all cause vertigo.

questions.question: 33558. Medial boundary of the femoral ring is formed by:
questions.explain:
✅ Why C is correct:
The femoral ring is bounded medially by the lacunar ligament, laterally by the femoral vein, anteriorly by the inguinal ligament, and posteriorly by the pectineus muscle.

questions.question: 33557. Which disease is the not mimicking anxiety disorder?
questions.explain:
✅ Why B is correct:
● Hypothyroidism causes depression, fatigue, not typically anxiety symptoms.

❌ Incorrect:
● Alcohol withdrawal, hypoglycemia, and temporal lobe epilepsy can mimic anxiety symptoms.

questions.question: 33556. The supporting cells of nervous system is called:
questions.explain:
✅ Why B is correct:
● Neuroglia (glial cells) support, protect, and nourish neurons.

questions.question: 33555. In infants, defecation often follows a meal. The cause of colonic contractions in the situation is:
questions.explain:
✅ Why C is correct:
● The gastrocolic reflex is a normal response where food in the stomach triggers colonic contractions leading to defecation.

questions.question: 33554. Which of the following structure passes through the aortic opening of the diaphragm?
questions.explain:
✅ Why C is correct:
● The aortic hiatus transmits the aorta, thoracic duct, and azygos vein.
● Thoracic duct passes here specifically.

❌ Incorrect:
● Inferior vena cava passes through the caval opening.
● Vagal trunks pass through the esophageal hiatus.

questions.question: 33553. Parasitic infection associated with anemia is:
questions.explain:
✅ Why D is correct:
● Necator americanus (hookworm) causes blood loss anemia by attaching to intestinal mucosa.

❌ Incorrect:
● Loa loa, Wuchereria bancrofti, Onchocerca → cause filariasis, not anemia.

questions.question: 33552. X-linked recessive disorder is:
questions.explain:
✅ Why B is correct:
● Hemophilia A and B are classic X-linked recessive disorders.

❌ Incorrect:
● Alkaptonuria, polycystic kidney disease, Wilson’s disease are autosomal.

questions.question: 33551. Amount of Hb contained in late normoblast is:
questions.explain:
✅ Why C is correct:
● Late normoblast (orthochromatic normoblast) contains approximately 30 picograms of Hb.

questions.question: 33550. Detrusor muscle is a muscle of
questions.explain:
✅ Why D is correct:
● Detrusor muscle forms the muscular layer of the bladder wall, responsible for contraction during urination.

questions.question: 33549. Acute heart failure may occur in:
questions.explain:
✅ Why C is correct:
● Myxedema (severe hypothyroidism) can cause acute heart failure due to decreased cardiac contractility and output.

❌ Incorrect:
● Rheumatoid arthritis, leprosy → no direct cause of acute heart failure.
● Rheumatic fever causes chronic valvular damage, not acute heart failure.

questions.question: 33548. Christmas disease develops due to deficiency of clotting factor:
questions.explain:
✅ Why D is correct:
● Christmas disease = Hemophilia B, caused by factor IX deficiency.

❌ Incorrect:
● Factor VIII deficiency causes Hemophilia A.
● Factors V and VII are unrelated.

questions.question: 33547. Which of the following is a tumoros marker?
questions.explain:
✅ Why B is correct:
● CA 19-9 → tumor marker for pancreatic, biliary cancers.

❌ Incorrect:
● PSA = for prostate cancer (also tumor marker, but not option B).
● CRP = inflammation marker.
● Ferritin = iron stores.

questions.question: 33546. Modifiable risk factor of hypertension is:
questions.explain:
✅ Why B is correct:
● Smoking = modifiable risk factor (lifestyle changeable).

❌ Incorrect:
● Age, sex, family history → non-modifiable.

questions.question: 33545. Milk ejection in female is caused by:
questions.explain:
✅ Why D is correct:
● Oxytocin → milk ejection reflex (myoepithelial cell contraction).

❌ Incorrect:
● Prolactin → milk production, not ejection.
● Estrogen/progesterone → inhibit lactation during pregnancy.

questions.question: 33544. The rectum:
questions.option1: Begins infront of the 1st sacral vertebra
questions.option2: Has a lining of stratified squamous epithelium
questions.option3: Is related anteriorly to the cervix
questions.option4: Has a venous drainage into the superior vena cava
questions.explain:
✅ Why C is correct:
● In females, rectum lies posterior to cervix and vagina.

❌ Incorrect:
● Begins at S3 vertebra (not S1).
● Lining: columnar, not stratified squamous.
● Venous drainage → portal system (not SVC).

questions.question: 33543. Confirmatory marker for Viremic stage of Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is:
questions.explain:
✅ Why C is correct:
● HBV DNA = direct marker of active viral replication (viremia).

❌ Incorrect:
● HBsAg = surface antigen, not viral load.
● Anti-HBs = immunity.
● Anti-HBc IgG = past infection.

questions.question: 33542. DNA is found in-
questions.explain:
✅ Why C is correct:
● DNA is packaged into chromosomes.

❌ Incorrect:
● Golgi, ribosome, lysosome → no DNA.

questions.question: 33541. Features of fibroadenoma include:
questions.explain:
❌ Actually, fibroadenoma is most common in women under 30.
Most correct feature should be “usually single, mobile, painless mass” in younger women. So option C is NOT accurate — probably a miskey.
Correct answer should be: None of the options exactly correct — but if you must select, C is closest by exclusion.

questions.question: 33540. Extracellular structural protein is:
questions.explain:
✅ Why A is correct:
● Elastin → ECM protein for tissue elasticity.

❌ Incorrect:
● Keratin = intracellular structural protein.
● Tubulin = cytoskeletal protein.
● Gastrin = hormone.

questions.question: 33539. Male external genital organ includes:
questions.explain:
✅ Why C is correct:
● Penis = external genital organ.

❌ Incorrect:
● Seminal vesicle, epididymis, prostate → internal genital structures.

questions.question: 33538. Karyotype of Turner Syndrome is:
questions.explain:
✅ Why A is correct:
● Turner syndrome → missing one X chromosome → 45 XO.

❌ Incorrect:
● 45 XY = male.
● 46 XX = normal female.
● 47 XXY = Klinefelter’s.

questions.question: 33537. The drug of choice for cerebral malaria is-
questions.explain:
✅ Why B is correct:
● WHO recommends IV artesunate for cerebral malaria (fast acting, life saving).

❌ Incorrect options:
● Oral quinine: slower, used when IV unavailable.
● Doxycycline, sulfamethoxazole + pyrimethamine: adjunctive, not first-line for cerebral malaria.

questions.question: 33536. During accommodation reaction there is:
questions.option1: Constriction of pupil by sympathetic nerve
questions.option3: Increase in transverse diameter of lens
questions.explain:
✅ Why D is correct:
● Ciliary muscle contraction → lens curvature ↑ → near focus.

❌ Incorrect options:
● Pupil → parasympathetic.
● Suspensory ligaments relax (not contract).
● Transverse lens diameter is not an accurate description.

questions.question: 33535. BCG vaccine at birth causes:
questions.explain:
✅ Why C is correct:
● BCG → induces controlled local TB infection → cell-mediated immunity.

❌ Incorrect options:
● Does NOT prevent primary/secondary TB or MDR TB.

questions.question: 33534. Simple squamous epithelium is found in:
questions.explain:
✅ Why D is correct:
● Endothelium → simple squamous → allows exchange.

❌ Incorrect options:
● Gall bladder → columnar.
● Urinary bladder → transitional.
● Fallopian tube → ciliated columnar.

questions.question: 33533. Elastic cartilage is not found in:
questions.explain:
✅ Why D is correct:
● Epiphyseal plate → hyaline cartilage.

❌ Incorrect options:
● Auditory tube, epiglottis, auricle → elastic cartilage.

questions.question: 33532. Morphological appearance of necrosis is the result of:
questions.explain:
✅ Why A is correct:
● Denatured proteins + enzyme digestion → necrosis morphology.

❌ Incorrect options:
● Saponification → fat necrosis.
● Mummification → dry gangrene (late).
● Alkalosis: unrelated.

questions.question: 33531. Cardinal feature of atopic dermatitis is:
questions.explain:
✅ Why B is correct:
● Intense itching → scratching → eczema cycle.

❌ Incorrect options:
● Swelling, oily skin, ↑IgM → not primary features.

questions.question: 33530. Which of the following malignancies is associated with radiation?
questions.explain:
✅ Why D is correct:
● Ionizing radiation → DNA damage → ALL risk ↑.

❌ Incorrect options:
● Ovarian CA, MALToma, Burkitt’s: less clear radiation link.

questions.question: 33529. Exotoxin mediated disease is:
questions.explain:
✅ Why A is correct:
● Streptococcus pyogenes exotoxins → tissue necrosis.

❌ Incorrect options:
● Wegener's granulomatosis → autoimmune.
● Kuru, Nipah → prion/viral, no exotoxins.

questions.question: 33528. Urinary bladder is lined by.
questions.explain:
✅ Why B is correct:
● Transitional epithelium → allows stretch/expansion in urinary bladder.

❌ Incorrect options:
● Squamous: in skin.
● Columnar: GI tract.
● Cuboidal: glands/kidney tubules.

questions.question: 33527. Medial surface of brain is supplied by:
questions.explain:
✅ Why B is correct:
● ACA supplies medial surface of frontal/parietal lobes.

❌ Incorrect options:
● (a) MCA → lateral surface.
● (c) Vertebral → brainstem/posterior brain.
● (d) PICA → cerebellum/medulla.

questions.question: 33526. Which component is not present in CSF?
questions.explain:
✅ Why C is correct:
● Normal CSF → no RBCs. RBCs suggest pathology (bleed, trauma).

❌ Incorrect options:
● Glucose, protein, leucocytes → normal small amounts present.

questions.question: 33525. Extra pyramidal lesion causes:
questions.explain:
✅ Why C is correct:
● Cogwheel rigidity → hallmark of basal ganglia lesion (extrapyramidal).

❌ Incorrect options:
● (a) Flaccid paralysis → LMN.
● (b) Hyperkinesia → may occur but not specific.
● (d) Hyperreflexia → UMN.

questions.question: 33524. Which vitamin is not synthesized in body?
questions.explain:
✅ Why C is correct:
● Vitamin A must be obtained from diet.

❌ Incorrect options:
● Vit D: skin synthesis.
● Vit K, Biotin: gut flora.

questions.question: 33523. Serum sodium level is:
questions.explain:
✅ Why C is correct:
● Normal range: 135–145 mmol/L.

❌ Incorrect options:
● (a), (b), (d) → either too low or too high.

questions.question: 33522. Pre XDR tuberculosis means:
questions.option1: TB resistant to isoniazid and rifampicin
questions.option2: TB resistant to isoniazid and ciprofloxacin
questions.option3: TB resistant to isoniazid, rifampicin and ciprofloxacin
questions.option4: TB resistant to isoniazid, rifampicin and pyrazinamide
questions.explain:
✅ Why C is correct:
● Pre-XDR TB = MDR TB (INH + rifampicin) + resistance to a fluoroquinolone (like ciprofloxacin).

❌ Incorrect options:
● (a), (b), (d) → incomplete or incorrect definitions.

questions.question: 33521. The tissue macrophage is derived from:
questions.explain:
✅ Why B is correct:
● Circulating monocytes → tissue → differentiate to macrophages.

❌ Incorrect options:
● Lymphocytes, eosinophils, helper T cells → different lineage.

questions.question: 33520. Which one of the following acts as antioxidant?
questions.explain:
✅ Why A is correct:
● Ceruloplasmin → copper-binding protein → antioxidant role.

❌ Incorrect options:
● (b) Ionizing radiation, (c) H₂O₂, (d) Hypochlorous acid → pro-oxidants.

questions.question: 33519. Immediate blood transfusion reaction includes:
questions.explain:
✅ Why A is correct:
● Air embolism → rapid/immediate complication during transfusion.

❌ Incorrect options:
● (b) Hypercalcemia, (c) Hypokalemia: rare or delayed.
● (d) Circulatory overload → can be immediate but usually develops over time, not a "reaction" per se.

questions.question: 33518. Drug causing increased uric acid level is:
questions.explain:
✅ Why A is correct:
● Pyrazinamide → decreases renal uric acid excretion → hyperuricemia.

❌ Incorrect options:
● (b) Steroid: mild effect.
● (c) Colchicine: used to treat gout.
● (d) Levofloxacin: no effect on uric acid.

questions.question: 33517. Which of the following types of shock is caused by failure of the heart to pump effectively?
questions.explain:
✅ Why B is correct:
● Cardiogenic shock = failure of pump → ↓ CO.

❌ Incorrect options:
● (a) Septic → vasodilation
● (c) Hypovolemic → low volume
● (d) Anaphylactic → vasodilation

questions.question: 33516. Causes of bilateral leg swelling does not always include:
questions.explain:
✅ Why D is correct:
● DVT usually → unilateral swelling.

❌ Incorrect options:
● (a), (b), (c) → common causes of bilateral swelling.

questions.question: 33515. At which of the following phase of cardiac cycle does the atrioventricular valve open?
questions.explain:
✅ Why D is correct:
● AV valves open during ventricular diastole → blood flows into ventricles.

❌ Incorrect options:
● (a), (b), (c) occur when valves are closed.

questions.question: 33514. Basal cell carcinoma includes:
questions.option2: Typically at the non sun exposure
questions.option4: Early lesions of pale translucent papules
questions.explain:
✅ Why A is correct:
● BCC → locally invasive, rarely metastasizes.

❌ Incorrect options:
● (b) Occurs on sun-exposed skin.
● (c) RB gene not typically involved.
● (d) Lesion: pearly papule.

questions.question: 33513. Autonomic ganglion are:
questions.explain:
✅ Why C is correct:
● Preganglionic fibers release acetylcholine → cholinergic.

❌ Incorrect options:
● Adrenergic/noradrenergic apply to postganglionic sympathetic only.
